//: [fix4-hinge2] lid hinge round 4: geared spring / damper drive (hingekit4.py, numbers hingebal.py). Applied after fix3_hinge.json.

lid.//clr_r: tongue running fit 0.2 -> 0.07 mm radial inside, 0.17 outside (MIM tongue +-0.02, PTFE-filled POM liners +-0.03): the sector gear needs a held centre distance (contact ratio >= 1.1 over the whole 0.24 radial play)
lid.//band_t: no tape any more: the outer running clearance is clr_r + 0.1 (was clr_r + tape 0.2 + 0.1)
lid.//exit_a: mesh angle phi_p: pinion centre on this ray from Q (was the tape exit -45)

h3.//rail_split: slot in the outer rail for the pinion (4.0 wide, +-2.3 slot) over +-15 deg round the mesh; the two side lands stay

h4.//: hingekit4.DEF4 holds every default; keys here override them (dicts merge). Spring T0 / T75 = torque at the lid of both springs together before losses.

gear.//zone: teeth from phi_p - 87 to phi_p + 12 (tongue frame): the pinion tip circle reaches inside the tongue band within +-10 deg of the line of centres, so the band is toothed 10 deg beyond the mesh at closed (+ 1.5 over-travel) and at 75 deg
gear.//band: toothed band 3.0 of the 8.0 tongue (pinion 2.4 + 0.3 each side): Lewis 46 MPa / Hertz 490 MPa at the largest tooth force (16.7 N); keeps 2 x 2.5 mm full side lands: tongue section in the zone Z 15.1 mm3 (full 21.3) -> LC3 SF 2.1 with the tooth-root Kt 1.7 on the full corner moment
gear.//runout: the cut rises from the root circle to the full tongue radius over 5.5 deg at both zone ends (inside the pinion tip-circle clearance incl. the 1.5 deg bottom over-travel): no step at the root-side end
